## Samsung Electronics analyst targets diverge as Korea Investment raises and BNK cuts

Diverging sell-side targets on Samsung — the bellwether for DRAM and NAND pricing — are a direct read on where consensus sits regarding the memory cycle trough. A tech PM with memory-chain exposure should track which direction resolves first as a leading indicator for names like MU.

- Street is split on Samsung Electronics: Korea Investment has lifted its price target while BNK Securities has cut its target.
- The divergence reflects continued disagreement on timing and durability of a semiconductor cycle recovery.
- No specific target levels are present in the headline; the read is thesis uncertainty, not resolution.
